unresolved_items: The packet reports the MC3:DSPC:cholesterol:PEG2000-lipid ratio in the RNA-LNP fabrication method and identifies LNP1 as MC3-containing, but does not explicitly restate the full four-lipid composition for LNP1 in the same evidence passage.

LNP16 and LNP17 are compositionally identified by their co-encapsulated RNA contents, but their complete lipid composition is not explicitly linked to those formulation numbers in the supplied evidence.
The supplied packet does not report the post-dose timepoint for the LNP16 qPCR uptake outcome.
